overview: Social Issues: only 7 official questions – one in 2008 and six in Prelims 2024. 2024 style is current-affairs-linked: which State/district ran a scheme or lost a law, which portal or MHA tool does what, who defined communalism, statements on the Assam Movement. Casteism has no official question; other APPSC exams ask it via Article 17, inter-caste schemes and honour-killing cases.

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs; asked in other APPSC exams
possibility.what_they_ask: Natural targets: Article 17 (untouchability), PCR Act 1955 and SC/ST (PoA) Act 1989, Shakti Vahini (2018) on honour killing, Dr Ambedkar inter-caste marriage scheme, Narayana Guru's 'one caste, one religion, one God'.
Which scholar gave a quoted definition.

possibility.angle: Regionalism – domicile job quotas, statehood and capital debates
possibility.what_they_ask: State whose local-reservation law was struck down; related exams ask Srikrishna Committee, AP three-capitals Act and its repeal.

possibility.angle: Crime against women – MHA IT tools, cases, laws
possibility.what_they_ask: Which MHA tool does real-time crime alerts; city of a reported abuse case; related exams ask Disha Act, Shakti teams, Nirbhaya Act.
District/State behind a named anti-child-marriage initiative.
Portal name for enforcing the 1986 Act (as amended 2016); related: Bachpan Bachao Andolan (Satyarthi).

possibility.angle: Youth unrest and agitation – Assam and other movements
possibility.what_they_ask: Start year, leading body and objective of a movement (Assam), AP movements and their start years in related exams.

traps.trap: Shifts the start year of a movement to its later milestone [year shift]
traps.spot: Statement giving a year for AASU's Assam agitation
traps.fix: Assam Movement began 1979; the Assam Accord was signed in 1985 (cut-off 25 March 1971). 1983 is the year of the Nellie violence, not the start.
traps.pyq: 'started in 1983' is false; objective statement also false → None of the above [prelims-2024#80]

traps.trap: Gives another State that passed a similar local-quota law
traps.spot: AP, Haryana, Jharkhand, Karnataka – all debated domicile quotas
traps.fix: The law struck down by the High Court (2023) for 75% private-job quota was Haryana's 2020 Act.

traps.trap: Gives a sister MHA database for a different function
traps.fix: Cri-MAC = real-time sharing of crime alerts and inter-State coordination; ITSSO = tracking sexual-offence investigation; NDSO = offender registry.

traps.trap: Offers a scheme acronym from another ministry
traps.fix: PENCIL = child-labour enforcement portal; the others are education/innovation/defence-production platforms.

traps.trap: Attributes a definition to the best-known Indian historian
traps.spot: Quote on communalism with Bipan Chandra as an option
traps.fix: 'Political assertiveness of a community … in a plural society undergoing modernisation' is Melson and Wolpe; Bipan Chandra treats communalism as an ideology.

techniques.name: Keyword → function mapping for e-tools [tool names]
techniques.how: Read the function words in the stem (real-time, registry, investigation) and match to the tool's name.
techniques.example: 'dissemination … real time … interstate coordination' = multi-agency centre → Cri-MAC [prelims-2024#75]

techniques.name: Milestone timeline for movements
techniques.how: Fix start, peak and settlement years; test each statement's year against them.

techniques.name: Where-it-happened recall for State initiatives
techniques.how: Link each initiative to its State in a short list (Odisha ALIVA, AP Disha, Kerala Pink Patrol).

techniques.name: Struck-down vs passed check
techniques.how: When several States passed similar laws, ask which one the court struck down.
techniques.example: AP (2019) and Jharkhand also enacted quotas; Punjab & Haryana HC struck down Haryana's → Haryana [prelims-2024#105]

confusions.remember: Real-time crime alerts vs investigation tracking / sex-offender registry.
Child-labour portal vs other ministries' platforms.
Communalism as political assertiveness vs communalism as ideology.
AASU-led agitation start vs settlement (cut-off 25 March 1971).
Haryana's was struck down by the High Court (2023).
Abolition of untouchability vs Parliament alone may prescribe residence for jobs.
Satyarthi's NGO movement vs Odisha district's data-driven anti-child-marriage drive.
AP women-safety law vs central criminal law amendment after Dec 2012 case.

anchors: Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act 1986, amended 2016; PENCIL portal (2017).
Haryana State Employment of Local Candidates Act 2020 (75%) struck down by the High Court in 2023.
Cri-MAC – MHA real-time crime information platform.
Melson and Wolpe – communalism as political assertiveness of a community.
AP Reorganisation Act appointed day – 2 June 2014.
checklist: Which exact body, tool or portal does the stem's function describe?
Several States did something similar – which one does the stem single out (struck down, first, district)?
Test every year in a statement against the movement's start and settlement.
Definition quote: match the key phrase to the thinker, not the most famous name.
Not-yet-asked casteism: revise Article 17, PCR/PoA Acts and honour-killing guidelines.
